🏛 City budget — Ostmarch
• City budget: Police 30%, Public transport subsidy 20%, Defence contribution 10% - set by Sara (K7Q2M9A)

Each city period the budget spends up to 20% of the treasury.
A change takes effect 24h after it is announced.
After a change, the next one can be made 3d later.
🗳 This change goes to a vote of the City council before it is announced, and takes effect only if it passes.

✏️ Draft division:
• Police: 30%
• Hospital subsidy: 0%
• Public transport subsidy: 20%
• Education: 5%
• Infrastructure and repair: 0%
• City marketing: 0%
• Defence contribution: 10%
Total: 65% - 35% is not spent and stays in the treasury.
